title: What we track and why
intro: Four short answers, in plain words.

lines.label: What the board reads from Discord
lines.what: Your Discord name, your Discord user number, the builds you confirm, and what you send to Leeroy (commands, button presses, direct messages to it, and messages that mention it). Not your role list or your email. It does check whether Discord says you can manage the server. The board does not read your picture. A party card posted in Discord in October 2026 used profile pictures.
lines.why: To show you as yourself and keep your build on your own sheet.

lines.label: What is stored
lines.what: Your Discord id, your name, your builds, your sign-ups and your saved settings. Questions you ask Leeroy are kept too.
lines.why: So the board remembers you between visits and your guild sees one up-to-date sheet.

lines.label: Who can see it
lines.what: Anyone with the link, or anyone who asks the server, can read names, builds and sign-ups. Every line of your sheet has a hide switch. A line you hide is removed from the sheet list and the party list, together with the lines that come from it (hide your class and your spec goes too). Your name and role always stay shown, and so do your sign-up answers, the meeting place, and the times your sheet and your launch row last changed. While any member hides anything, the shared planning pages (decide, buffs, the atlas guide, tonight's suggestions) go blank and show one line: Part of this is hidden because a member keeps their build private. A change can take up to about 60 seconds to show, because pages are cached. The first members' builds are also written into the board's public code and older commits of the repo, and hiding a field does not remove them there. Your settings and your own sheet need your key. The people who run the board are named on the privacy page. Nobody sees it for ads, and we do not sell it.
lines.why: The board is open so the group can see who is coming and with what, without signing in.

lines.label: How to delete it
lines.what: You will be able to erase your data yourself, in one step.
lines.why: It is your data, so you should be able to take it back.
